title: Cleanup & Reliability Update
headline: This release streamlines the tweak library and improves the accuracy of hardware recommendations, backed by a round of interface polish and stability fixes.
changes: Removed: "Optimize MMCSS for Gaming" tweak — retired after testing showed it provided no measurable benefit and could introduce risk on some systems.
Improved: Hardware recommendations now disclose latency risks up front, so you know exactly what a tweak trades off before applying it.
Improved: Window controls and titlebar now float transparently over the app content for a cleaner, more modern look.
Improved: Page transitions are faster and more consistent across the app, with several stray animations removed for a snappier feel.
Fixed: Console warnings cleaned up across page navigation for smoother performance.
Fixed: Various minor visual inconsistencies in the app's top bar and page backgrounds.
